title: urtica dioica var. glabrata
intro: Urtica dioica var. glabrata, commonly known as Smooth Stinging Nettle, is a variant of the stinging nettle plant that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine. The leaves and roots of this plant have been found to possess numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, gout, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Smooth Stinging Nettle include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve circulation, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects and have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties.
